comparison.objective: Move five salmon pieces to a plate without robot-food contact by manipulating a board and knife.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual board positioning, stabilization, and tool sweeping; shares stabilization only, not precision locking or iterative tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Each piece reaches the plate and any robot-food contact zeros the score; spill/loss and plate-boundary tolerances are not detailed.
comparison.reason: Tests indirect food transfer and hygiene constraints.
